fighter-fighting-style.name: Fighting Style
fighter-fighting-style.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

fighter-second-wind.name: Second Wind
fighter-second-wind.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm.

fighter-action-surge.name: Action Surge
fighter-action-surge.description: On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

fighter-extra-attack.name: Extra Attack
fighter-extra-attack.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

fighter-indomitable.name: Indomitable
fighter-indomitable.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

champion-improved-critical.name: Improved Critical
champion-improved-critical.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

champion-remarkable-athlete.name: Remarkable Athlete
champion-remarkable-athlete.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any STR, DEX, or CON checks that don't already use your proficiency bonus.

champion-superior-critical.name: Superior Critical
champion-superior-critical.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

champion-survivor.name: Survivor
champion-survivor.description: At the start of each of your turns, regain hit points equal to 5 + CON mod if you have no more than half your hit points left.

battlemaster-combat-superiority.name: Combat Superiority
battlemaster-combat-superiority.description: Learn three maneuvers and gain four superiority dice (d8s) to fuel them.

battlemaster-know-your-enemy.name: Know Your Enemy
battlemaster-know-your-enemy.description: Study a creature for 1 minute to learn how it compares to you in two characteristics.

battlemaster-relentless.name: Relentless
battlemaster-relentless.description: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain one.

eldritchknight-spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
eldritchknight-spellcasting.description: Learn two cantrips and three 1st-level wizard spells. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

eldritchknight-war-magic.name: War Magic
eldritchknight-war-magic.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

eldritchknight-eldritch-strike.name: Eldritch Strike
eldritchknight-eldritch-strike.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it has disadvantage on the next saving throw against a spell you cast.

eldritchknight-arcane-charge.name: Arcane Charge
eldritchknight-arcane-charge.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

eldritchknight-improved-war-magic.name: Improved War Magic
eldritchknight-improved-war-magic.description: When you cast a spell (not just a cantrip), you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

fighting-style-archery.name: Fighting Style: Archery
fighting-style-archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

fighting-style-defense.name: Fighting Style: Defense
fighting-style-defense.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

fighting-style-dueling.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
fighting-style-dueling.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

fighting-style-great-weapon-fighting.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
fighting-style-great-weapon-fighting.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

fighting-style-protection.name: Fighting Style: Protection
fighting-style-protection.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

fighting-style-two-weapon-fighting.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighting-style-two-weapon-fighting.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

dwarf-darkvision.name: Darkvision (120 ft.)
dwarf-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

dwarf-dwarven-resilience.name: Dwarven Resilience
dwarf-dwarven-resilience.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

dwarf-stonecunning.name: Stonecunning
dwarf-stonecunning.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus.

halfling-lucky.name: Lucky
halfling-lucky.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

halfling-brave.name: Brave
halfling-brave.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

halfling-naturally-stealthy.name: Naturally Stealthy
halfling-naturally-stealthy.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

halfling-stout-resilience.name: Stout Resilience
halfling-stout-resilience.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

rogue-sneak-attack.name: Sneak Attack
rogue-sneak-attack.description: Once per turn, deal extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with a finesse or ranged weapon attack if you have advantage or an ally is within 5 feet of the target. Scales to ceil(level/2)d6.

rogue-thieves-cant.name: Thieves' Cant
rogue-thieves-cant.description: You have learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation.

rogue-cunning-action.name: Cunning Action
rogue-cunning-action.description: You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

rogue-uncanny-dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
rogue-uncanny-dodge.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

rogue-evasion.name: Evasion
rogue-evasion.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a DEX save to take half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure.

thief-fast-hands.name: Fast Hands
thief-fast-hands.description: Use Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

thief-second-story-work.name: Second-Story Work
thief-second-story-work.description: Climbing no longer costs extra movement. When you make a running jump, the distance increases by a number of feet equal to your DEX modifier.

thief-supreme-sneak.name: Supreme Sneak
thief-supreme-sneak.description: You have advantage on DEX (Stealth) checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

assassin-assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassin-assassinate.description: You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet. Any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

assassin-infiltration-expertise.name: Infiltration Expertise
assassin-infiltration-expertise.description: You can create false identities. Spend 7 days and 25 gp to establish history, profession, and affiliations for an identity.

arcanetrickster-mage-hand-legerdemain.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
arcanetrickster-mage-hand-legerdemain.description: When you cast mage hand, you can make it invisible and use it to stow/retrieve objects or use thieves' tools at range.

arcanetrickster-magical-ambush.name: Magical Ambush
arcanetrickster-magical-ambush.description: If hidden when you cast a spell, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against it this turn.

human-resourceful.name: Resourceful
human-resourceful.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

dwarf-dwarven-toughness.name: Dwarven Toughness
dwarf-dwarven-toughness.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

elf-darkvision.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
elf-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

elf-fey-ancestry.name: Fey Ancestry
elf-fey-ancestry.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

elf-trance.name: Trance
elf-trance.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation.

gnome-darkvision.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
gnome-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

gnome-gnomish-cunning.name: Gnomish Cunning
gnome-gnomish-cunning.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

halfling-halfling-nimbleness.name: Halfling Nimbleness
halfling-halfling-nimbleness.description: You can move through the space of any creature of a size larger than yours.

aasimar-darkvision.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
aasimar-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

aasimar-celestial-resistance.name: Celestial Resistance
aasimar-celestial-resistance.description: You have resistance to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

aasimar-healing-hands.name: Healing Hands
aasimar-healing-hands.description: As a Magic action, you touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The creature regains a number of Hit Points equal to the total rolled.

aasimar-light-bearer.name: Light Bearer
aasimar-light-bearer.description: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

aasimar-celestial-revelation.name: Celestial Revelation
aasimar-celestial-revelation.description: When you reach character level 3, you can transform as a Bonus Action. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a Bonus Action.

dragonborn-darkvision.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
dragonborn-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

dragonborn-darkvision-120.name: Darkvision (120 ft.)
dragonborn-darkvision-120.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

dragonborn-breath-chromatic-black.name: Breath Weapon (Acid)
dragonborn-breath-chromatic-black.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-chromatic-blue.name: Breath Weapon (Lightning)
dragonborn-breath-chromatic-blue.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-chromatic-green.name: Breath Weapon (Poison)
dragonborn-breath-chromatic-green.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-chromatic-red.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-metallic-brass.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-metallic-bronze.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-metallic-copper.name: Breath Weapon (Acid)
dragonborn-breath-metallic-copper.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-metallic-gold.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-metallic-silver.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-gem-amethyst.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-gem-emerald.name: Breath Weapon (Psychic)
dragonborn-breath-gem-emerald.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-gem-sapphire.name: Breath Weapon (Thunder)
dragonborn-breath-gem-sapphire.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-gem-topaz.name: Breath Weapon (Necrotic)
dragonborn-breath-gem-topaz.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

dragonborn-breath-gem-crystal.name: Breath Weapon (Radiant)
dragonborn-breath-gem-crystal.description: You exhale destructive energy. When you use your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The type of saving throw and the damage type are determined by your Draconic Lineage.

goliath-large-form.name: Large Form
goliath-large-form.description: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts until you end it as a Bonus Action or until you die.

goliath-powerful-build.name: Powerful Build
goliath-powerful-build.description: You have Advantage on any saving throw you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

goliath-giant-ancestry-cloud.name: Giant Ancestry (Cloud)
goliath-giant-ancestry-cloud.description: You are descended from Cloud Giants. You can cast Fog Cloud with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Misty Step with it. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Cloud of Daggers with it.

goliath-giant-ancestry-fire.name: Giant Ancestry (Fire)
goliath-giant-ancestry-fire.description: You are descended from Fire Giants. You can cast Burning Hands with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Flame Blade with it. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Fireball with it.

goliath-giant-ancestry-frost.name: Giant Ancestry (Frost)
goliath-giant-ancestry-frost.description: You are descended from Frost Giants. You can cast Armor of Agathys with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Hold Person with it. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Sleet Storm with it.

goliath-giant-ancestry-hill.name: Giant Ancestry (Hill)
goliath-giant-ancestry-hill.description: You are descended from Hill Giants. You can cast Speak with Animals with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Entangle with it. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Erupting Earth with it.

goliath-giant-ancestry-stone.name: Giant Ancestry (Stone)
goliath-giant-ancestry-stone.description: You are descended from Stone Giants. You can cast Entangle with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Spike Growth with it. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Meld into Stone with it.

goliath-giant-ancestry-storm.name: Giant Ancestry (Storm)
goliath-giant-ancestry-storm.description: You are descended from Storm Giants. You can cast Thunderwave with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Levitate with it. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Call Lightning with it.

orc-adrenaline-rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
orc-adrenaline-rush.description: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

orc-darkvision.name: Darkvision (120 ft.)
orc-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

orc-powerful-build.name: Powerful Build
orc-powerful-build.description: You have Advantage on any saving throw you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

orc-relentless-endurance.name: Relentless Endurance
orc-relentless-endurance.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

tiefling-darkvision.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
tiefling-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

tiefling-fiendish-legacy-abyssal.name: Fiendish Legacy (Abyssal)
tiefling-fiendish-legacy-abyssal.description: You are the recipient of a demonic legacy. You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also know the Poison Spray cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Ray of Sickness. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Hold Person.

tiefling-fiendish-legacy-chthonic.name: Fiendish Legacy (Chthonic)
tiefling-fiendish-legacy-chthonic.description: You are the recipient of a chthonic legacy. You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. You also know the Chill Touch cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast False Life. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Ray of Enfeeblement.

tiefling-fiendish-legacy-infernal.name: Fiendish Legacy (Infernal)
tiefling-fiendish-legacy-infernal.description: You are the recipient of an infernal legacy. You have Resistance to Fire damage. You also know the Fire Bolt cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Darkness.

elf-drow-darkvision.name: Drow Darkvision (120 ft.)
elf-drow-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

elf-drow-dancing-lights.name: Dancing Lights
elf-drow-dancing-lights.description: You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-drow-faerie-fire.name: Faerie Fire
elf-drow-faerie-fire.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Faerie Fire using this trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-drow-darkness.name: Darkness
elf-drow-darkness.description: Starting at 5th level, you can cast Darkness using this trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-high-elf-cantrip.name: High Elf Cantrip
elf-high-elf-cantrip.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-high-elf-detect-magic.name: Detect Magic
elf-high-elf-detect-magic.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Detect Magic using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-high-elf-misty-step.name: Misty Step
elf-high-elf-misty-step.description: Starting at 5th level, you can cast Misty Step using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-wood-elf-druidcraft.name: Druidcraft
elf-wood-elf-druidcraft.description: You know the Druidcraft cantrip. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-wood-elf-longstrider.name: Longstrider
elf-wood-elf-longstrider.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Longstrider using this trait. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

elf-wood-elf-pass-without-trace.name: Pass Without Trace
elf-wood-elf-pass-without-trace.description: Starting at 5th level, you can cast Pass Without Trace using this trait. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-forest-minor-illusion.name: Minor Illusion
gnome-forest-minor-illusion.description: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-forest-speak-with-animals.name: Speak with Animals
gnome-forest-speak-with-animals.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Speak with Animals using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-forest-misty-step.name: Misty Step
gnome-forest-misty-step.description: Starting at 5th level, you can cast Misty Step using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-rock-mending.name: Mending
gnome-rock-mending.description: You know the Mending cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-rock-prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
gnome-rock-prestidigitation.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Prestidigitation using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-rock-animate-objects.name: Animate Objects
gnome-rock-animate-objects.description: Starting at 5th level, you can cast Animate Objects using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-deep-darkvision.name: Deep Gnome Darkvision (120 ft.)
gnome-deep-darkvision.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

gnome-deep-disguise-self.name: Disguise Self
gnome-deep-disguise-self.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Disguise Self using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

gnome-deep-nondetection.name: Nondetection
gnome-deep-nondetection.description: Starting at 5th level, you can cast Nondetection using this trait. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

barbarian-rage.name: Rage
barbarian-rage.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action.

barbarian-unarmored-defense.name: Unarmored Defense
barbarian-unarmored-defense.description: While you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier.

barbarian-reckless-attack.name: Reckless Attack
barbarian-reckless-attack.description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly.

barbarian-danger-sense.name: Danger Sense
barbarian-danger-sense.description: You gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger.

barbarian-extra-attack.name: Extra Attack
barbarian-extra-attack.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

barbarian-fast-movement.name: Fast Movement
barbarian-fast-movement.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

barbarian-feral-instinct.name: Feral Instinct
barbarian-feral-instinct.description: Your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.

barbarian-instinctive-pounce.name: Instinctive Pounce
barbarian-instinctive-pounce.description: As part of the bonus action you take to enter your rage, you can move up to half your speed.

barbarian-brutal-strike.name: Brutal Strike
barbarian-brutal-strike.description: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo advantage on one Strength-based attack roll and instead have that attack deal extra damage.

barbarian-relentless-rage.name: Relentless Rage
barbarian-relentless-rage.description: Your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you're raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw.

barbarian-improved-brutal-strike.name: Improved Brutal Strike
barbarian-improved-brutal-strike.description: Your Brutal Strike feature improves, granting additional effects when you forgo advantage.

barbarian-persistent-rage.name: Persistent Rage
barbarian-persistent-rage.description: Your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.

barbarian-improved-brutal-strike-2.name: Improved Brutal Strike (Greater)
barbarian-improved-brutal-strike-2.description: Your Brutal Strike feature improves further.

barbarian-indomitable-might.name: Indomitable Might
barbarian-indomitable-might.description: If your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

barbarian-primal-champion.name: Primal Champion
barbarian-primal-champion.description: You embody primal power. Your Strength score increases by 4, and your Constitution score increases by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

bard-bardic-inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
bard-bardic-inspiration.description: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. As a bonus action, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to give a creature you can see within 60 feet an inspiration die.

bard-jack-of-all-trades.name: Jack of All Trades
bard-jack-of-all-trades.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

bard-song-of-rest.name: Song of Rest
bard-song-of-rest.description: You can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest.

bard-font-of-inspiration.name: Font of Inspiration
bard-font-of-inspiration.description: You regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

bard-countercharm.name: Countercharm
bard-countercharm.description: You gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects.

bard-magical-secrets.name: Magical Secrets
bard-magical-secrets.description: You have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any classes.

bard-superior-inspiration.name: Superior Inspiration
bard-superior-inspiration.description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

bard-words-of-creation.name: Words of Creation
bard-words-of-creation.description: You have mastered the Words of Creation, the primordial language of the universe.

bard-epic-boon.name: Epic Boon
bard-epic-boon.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice.

cleric-divine-order.name: Divine Order
cleric-divine-order.description: You have dedicated yourself to one of two divine orders: Protector or Thaumaturge.

cleric-channel-divinity.name: Channel Divinity
cleric-channel-divinity.description: You gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects.

cleric-holy-order.name: Holy Order
cleric-holy-order.description: You gain one of the following options of your choice: Protector, Thaumaturge, or War Priest.

cleric-smite-undead.name: Smite Undead
cleric-smite-undead.description: You can cause your Turn Undead feature to smite the undead. When you use Turn Undead, you can expend a spell slot to deal Radiant damage to undead that fail their saving throws.

cleric-blessed-strikes.name: Blessed Strikes
cleric-blessed-strikes.description: Divine power infuses you in battle. When you deal damage to a creature, you can also deal 1d8 Radiant damage to that creature.

cleric-divine-intervention.name: Divine Intervention
cleric-divine-intervention.description: You can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf. As an action, describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice.

cleric-channel-divinity-3.name: Channel Divinity (3/Rest)
cleric-channel-divinity-3.description: You can use Channel Divinity three times between rests.

cleric-greater-divine-intervention.name: Greater Divine Intervention
cleric-greater-divine-intervention.description: Your Divine Intervention now always succeeds. Once you use it, you can't use it again until 2d4 days have passed.

druid-primal-order.name: Primal Order
druid-primal-order.description: You have dedicated yourself to one of the following sacred roles of your choice: Magician or Warden.

druid-wild-shape.name: Wild Shape
druid-wild-shape.description: You can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before.

druid-wild-companion.name: Wild Companion
druid-wild-companion.description: You can expend a spell slot to cast Find Familiar without material components, calling a spirit that takes the form of a beast.

druid-wild-shape-improvement-1.name: Wild Shape Improvement
druid-wild-shape-improvement-1.description: Your Wild Shape improves, allowing you to transform into beasts with a higher challenge rating.

druid-wild-resurgence.name: Wild Resurgence
druid-wild-resurgence.description: Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot.

druid-wild-shape-improvement-2.name: Wild Shape Improvement (Greater)
druid-wild-shape-improvement-2.description: Your Wild Shape improves further, allowing you to transform into beasts with a higher challenge rating.

druid-elemental-fury.name: Elemental Fury
druid-elemental-fury.description: The might of the elements flows through you. You gain the Potent Spellcasting or Primal Strike feature.

druid-improved-elemental-fury.name: Improved Elemental Fury
druid-improved-elemental-fury.description: The power you gained from the Elemental Fury feature becomes mightier.

druid-beast-spells.name: Beast Spells
druid-beast-spells.description: You can cast many of your Druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape.

druid-archdruid.name: Archdruid
druid-archdruid.description: The vitality of nature constantly blooms within you, granting you the following benefits.

monk-martial-arts.name: Martial Arts
monk-martial-arts.description: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use unarmed strikes and monk weapons.

monk-unarmored-defense.name: Unarmored Defense
monk-unarmored-defense.description: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

monk-focus-points.name: Focus Points
monk-focus-points.description: Your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of Focus Points. Your Monk level determines the number of points you have.

monk-unarmored-movement.name: Unarmored Movement
monk-unarmored-movement.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield.

monk-uncanny-metabolism.name: Uncanny Metabolism
monk-uncanny-metabolism.description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended Focus Points. When you do so, roll your Martial Arts die, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Monk level plus the number rolled.

monk-deflect-attacks.name: Deflect Attacks
monk-deflect-attacks.description: You can use your reaction to deflect the strike when you are hit by an attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced.

monk-slow-fall.name: Slow Fall
monk-slow-fall.description: You can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any fall damage you take by an amount equal to five times your Monk level.

monk-extra-attack.name: Extra Attack
monk-extra-attack.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

monk-stunning-strike.name: Stunning Strike
monk-stunning-strike.description: You can interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with an attack, you can spend 1 focus point to attempt a stunning strike.

monk-empowered-strikes.name: Empowered Strikes
monk-empowered-strikes.description: Whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

monk-evasion.name: Evasion
monk-evasion.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed.

monk-stillness-of-mind.name: Stillness of Mind
monk-stillness-of-mind.description: You can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

monk-acrobatic-movement.name: Acrobatic Movement
monk-acrobatic-movement.description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling during the move.

monk-heightened-focus.name: Heightened Focus
monk-heightened-focus.description: Your Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind gain additional benefits.

monk-self-restoration.name: Self-Restoration
monk-self-restoration.description: Through sheer force of will, you can remove one of the following conditions from yourself at the end of each of your turns: Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned.

monk-disciplined-survivor.name: Disciplined Survivor
monk-disciplined-survivor.description: Your physical and mental discipline grant you proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 focus point to reroll it and take the second result.

monk-perfect-focus.name: Perfect Focus
monk-perfect-focus.description: When you roll Initiative and have fewer than 4 Focus Points, you regain Focus Points equal to 4 minus your current total.

monk-diamond-soul.name: Diamond Soul
monk-diamond-soul.description: Your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.

monk-superior-defense.name: Superior Defense
monk-superior-defense.description: At the start of your turn, you can spend 3 Focus Points to perfectly clear your mind and body, gaining resistance to all damage except Force damage until the start of your next turn.

monk-body-and-mind.name: Body and Mind
monk-body-and-mind.description: You have honed your body and mind to new heights. Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores increase by 4, and your maximum for those scores is now 25.

monk-epic-boon.name: Epic Boon
monk-epic-boon.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice.

paladin-lay-on-hands.name: Lay On Hands
paladin-lay-on-hands.description: Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you take a long rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of hit points equal to your paladin level × 5.

paladin-divine-sense.name: Divine Sense
paladin-divine-sense.description: The presence of strong evil registers on your senses like a noxious odor, and powerful good rings like heavenly music in your ears.

paladin-divine-smite.name: Divine Smite
paladin-divine-smite.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal Radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage.

paladin-channel-divinity.name: Channel Divinity
paladin-channel-divinity.description: Your sacred oath lets you channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. Each Channel Divinity option provided by your oath explains how to use it.

paladin-extra-attack.name: Extra Attack
paladin-extra-attack.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

paladin-faithful-steed.name: Faithful Steed
paladin-faithful-steed.description: You can call on the aid of an otherworldly steed. You always have the Find Steed spell prepared.

paladin-aura-of-protection.name: Aura of Protection
paladin-aura-of-protection.description: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier.

paladin-abjure-foes.name: Abjure Foes
paladin-abjure-foes.description: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with divine awe.

paladin-aura-of-courage.name: Aura of Courage
paladin-aura-of-courage.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious.

paladin-radiant-strikes.name: Radiant Strikes
paladin-radiant-strikes.description: You are so suffused with divine might that your weapon strikes carry supernatural power with them. When you hit a target with a melee weapon attack, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

paladin-restoring-touch.name: Restoring Touch
paladin-restoring-touch.description: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned.

paladin-aura-expansion.name: Aura Expansion
paladin-aura-expansion.description: Your Aura of Protection now extends 30 feet rather than 10 feet.

paladin-epic-boon.name: Epic Boon
paladin-epic-boon.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice.

ranger-favored-enemy.name: Favored Enemy
ranger-favored-enemy.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track your favored enemies, as well as on Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

ranger-weapon-mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
ranger-weapon-mastery.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency.

ranger-deft-explorer.name: Deft Explorer
ranger-deft-explorer.description: You are an unsurpassed explorer and survivor, both in the wilderness and in dealing with others on your travels.

ranger-roving.name: Roving
ranger-roving.description: Your walking speed increases by 10, and you gain a climbing speed and a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

ranger-extra-attack.name: Extra Attack
ranger-extra-attack.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

ranger-conjure-barrage.name: Conjure Barrage
ranger-conjure-barrage.description: You always have the Conjure Barrage spell prepared.

ranger-tireless.name: Tireless
ranger-tireless.description: As an action, you can give yourself a number of temporary hit points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier. You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

ranger-relentless-hunter.name: Relentless Hunter
ranger-relentless-hunter.description: Taking damage can't break your concentration on Hunter's Mark.

ranger-natures-veil.name: Nature's Veil
ranger-natures-veil.description: You can use nature magic to hide your presence. As a bonus action, you can magically become invisible, along with any equipment you are wearing or carrying, until the start of your next turn.

ranger-conjure-volley.name: Conjure Volley
ranger-conjure-volley.description: You always have the Conjure Volley spell prepared.

ranger-swift-quiver.name: Swift Quiver
ranger-swift-quiver.description: You always have the Swift Quiver spell prepared.

ranger-epic-boon.name: Epic Boon
ranger-epic-boon.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice.

sorcerer-innate-sorcery.name: Innate Sorcery
sorcerer-innate-sorcery.description: An event in your past, or in the past of a parent or ancestor, left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with a mote of magic. This unpredictable magic is a sorcery that is part of you.

sorcerer-font-of-magic.name: Font of Magic
sorcerer-font-of-magic.description: You tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. This wellspring is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects.

sorcerer-metamagic.name: Metamagic
sorcerer-metamagic.description: You gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two of the following Metamagic options of your choice.

sorcerer-sorcery-incarnate.name: Sorcery Incarnate
sorcerer-sorcery-incarnate.description: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can use it again, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

sorcerer-metamagic-options.name: Metamagic Options
sorcerer-metamagic-options.description: You gain two more Metamagic options of your choice.

sorcerer-arcane-apotheosis.name: Arcane Apotheosis
sorcerer-arcane-apotheosis.description: While your Innate Sorcery feature is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without expending Sorcery Points on it.

sorcerer-sorcerous-restoration.name: Sorcerous Restoration
sorcerer-sorcerous-restoration.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you regain expended Sorcery Points, but no more than a number equal to half your Sorcerer level.

warlock-eldritch-invocations.name: Eldritch Invocations
warlock-eldritch-invocations.description: In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability.

warlock-magical-cunning.name: Magical Cunning
warlock-magical-cunning.description: You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute. At the end of it, you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots up to half of their maximum number (round up).

warlock-pact-magic-enhancement.name: Pact Magic Enhancement
warlock-pact-magic-enhancement.description: Your pact magic grows as you advance, granting you additional spell slots.

warlock-pact-boon.name: Pact Boon
warlock-pact-boon.description: Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service. You gain one of the following features of your choice: Pact of the Blade, Pact of the Chain, or Pact of the Tome.

warlock-mystic-arcanum-6.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th Level)
warlock-mystic-arcanum-6.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list as this arcanum.

warlock-mystic-arcanum-7.name: Mystic Arcanum (7th Level)
warlock-mystic-arcanum-7.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 7th-level spell from the warlock spell list as this arcanum.

warlock-mystic-arcanum-8.name: Mystic Arcanum (8th Level)
warlock-mystic-arcanum-8.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 8th-level spell from the warlock spell list as this arcanum.

warlock-mystic-arcanum-9.name: Mystic Arcanum (9th Level)
warlock-mystic-arcanum-9.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 9th-level spell from the warlock spell list as this arcanum.

warlock-eldritch-master.name: Eldritch Master
warlock-eldritch-master.description: You can draw on your inner reserve of mystical power while entreating your patron to regain expended spell slots. You can spend 1 minute entreating your patron for aid to regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.

wizard-arcane-recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
wizard-arcane-recovery.description: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook. Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover.

wizard-scholar.name: Scholar
wizard-scholar.description: You have an exceptional understanding of magical theory. Whenever you gain a Wizard level, you can add two Wizard spells to your spellbook for free.

wizard-memorize-spell.name: Memorize Spell
wizard-memorize-spell.description: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells you have prepared for your Spellcasting feature with another level 1+ spell from your spellbook.

wizard-spell-mastery.name: Spell Mastery
wizard-spell-mastery.description: You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a 1st-level and a 2nd-level wizard spell that you have in your spellbook. You can cast those spells at their lowest level without expending a spell slot when you have them prepared.

wizard-signature-spells.name: Signature Spells
wizard-signature-spells.description: You gain mastery over two powerful spells and can cast them with little effort. Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook as your signature spells.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

battlemaster.name: Battle Master
battlemaster.description: Those who emulate the Battle Master archetype employ martial techniques passed down through generations. A Battle Master uses superiority dice to fuel special maneuvers that grant tactical advantage in combat.

eldritchknight.name: Eldritch Knight
eldritchknight.description: The Eldritch Knight combines martial prowess with careful study of magic. These fighters learn to cast spells from the wizard spell list, weaving magic into their weapon strikes and defenses.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: You hone your skills in the larcenous arts. Burglars, bandits, cutpurses, and other criminals typically follow this archetype.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: You focus your training on the grim art of death. Hired killers, spies, bounty hunters, and specially anointed priests follow this archetype.

arcanetrickster.name: Arcane Trickster
arcanetrickster.description: Some rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with magic, learning tricks of enchantment and illusion.

archery.name: Archery
archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

defense.name: Defense
defense.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

dueling.name: Dueling
dueling.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

great-weapon-fighting.name: Great Weapon Fighting
great-weapon-fighting.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property.

protection.name: Protection
protection.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

two-weapon-fighting.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
two-weapon-fighting.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

martial-weapon-and-shield.name: A martial weapon and a shield
